name: キッチン南海 神保町店
address_ja: 〒101-0051 東京都千代田区神田神保町1-39-8 ハウス神保町 1F
cuisine: The Jimbocho black curry — a near-black, ten-spice pork-and-onion roux simmered and rested over about ten hours, ladled over rice and shredded cabbage under a thick-crumbed katsu; katsu curry ¥750, plain curry rice ¥550, plates like flounder-fry with ginger pork ¥900, and almost nothing on the board tops ¥1,000.
neighborhood: Kanda-Jimbocho 1-chōme, on the Chiyoda-dōri side of the book district — 4 min from Jimbochō (Toei Mita and Shinjuku lines, Tokyo Metro Hanzōmon line), 9 min from Ochanomizu (JR Chūō/Sōbu).
hours_raw: 月・火・水・木・金・土 11:15 - 15:00 / 17:00 - 19:30　日・祝日 定休日　※売り切れ次第終了
gf_detail: Nothing here is safe for celiac and the shop makes no gluten-free claim. The signature roux is a wheat-flour curry roux; every fried item is dredged in flour and coarse butter-enriched fresh panko (the shop describes the crumb itself as a selling point) and everything goes through the same fryer; the yōshoku sides run on ordinary wheat soy sauce and Worcestershire-style sauce. A 15-seat counter with one fryer has no separate-preparation route.
vegan_detail: No plant-based option. The curry roux is built on pork and animal fat, the menu is katsu, fried flounder, ginger pork and cream croquettes, and the only meatless additions are raw egg, cheese and cabbage. No vegetarian plate is published.

roles: former 料理長 of キッチン南海 本店 for over 20 years
chef_bio.origin: Kanda-Jimbocho, Chiyoda-ku — three minutes' walk from where the original shop stood on Suzuran-dōri
chef_bio.background: キッチン南海 was founded in Jimbocho in 1966 and became the shop most often credited with the Jimbocho style of near-black curry. The original 本店 closed in June 2020 because the building had aged out. In July 2020 Nakajō — head chef at the 本店 for more than twenty years — opened キッチン南海 神保町店 about three minutes away toward Chiyoda-dōri, opposite Jimbocho Kagetsu, carrying the 本店 recipe over intact. Tabelog's own listing flags the distinction explicitly: this is an independent のれん分け shop, not a relocation of the Suzuran-dōri original. It has been selected for Tabelog's 洋食 百名店 in both 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Nakajō on the roux: 「ルーは煮込みと寝かしを繰り返し、合計10時間ほどの時間をかけてつくっています。マヨネーズを加えると少し辛さがマイルドになりますよ」 — repeated simmering and resting over roughly ten hours, and a spoon of mayonnaise if the heat is too much for you.
chef_bio.specialty: カツカレー ¥750 — coarse, slightly sweet butter-enriched fresh panko that stands up in thick spikes when fried so the roux clings to it, over rice and shredded cabbage. Everything fried is fried to order.

anecdotes.text: The Chiyoda City tourist association reports regulars who have been eating this curry for over forty years, and that the lunch queue now spills out of the door — with 14:00–15:00 the quiet window worth aiming for.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 千代田区観光協会 (Visit Chiyoda, spot 388) gives the founding year 1966, the June 2020 closure of the 本店 for building deterioration, the July 2020 opening of 神保町店 three minutes away, and identifies the owner as 中條さん, 料理長 at the 本店 for over twenty years — so the 本店 flavour carried over. It also lists 14 counter seats, hours 11:15～15:00 / 17:00～19:30 closed Sundays and holidays, カツカレー ¥750, カレーライス ¥550, ひらめフライ生姜焼きライス ¥900, エビフライクリームコロッケライス ¥850, add-ons チキンカツ ¥300 / えびフライ ¥350 from 13:00, and toppings なまたまご ¥50 / チーズ ¥100 / キャベツ ¥50. Tabelog 13249021 gives 神田神保町1-39-8 ハウス神保町1F, 03-3219-1616, coordinates 35.69484/139.76067, 15 counter seats, all non-smoking, cash only, no reservations, opened 2020年7月29日, budget ～￥999, rating 3.66 over 1,892 reviews, 洋食百名店 2023 and 2025, and the caution 「神保町花月の向かいにのれん分け独立店「キッチン南海」を新規開店。すずらん通りにあった同名店が移転したのではないので、要注意。」

gf_cross_contamination.text: One 15-seat counter, one fryer: katsu, flounder fry, prawn fry and cream croquettes all share it, and every one of them is breaded in wheat flour and panko.

cultural_comfort.note: A 15-seat counter that fills at lunch and queues out the door; cash only, no cards, no electronic money, no reservations. Nothing published indicates an English menu, and the ordering rhythm is fast — decide before you sit. Turn up between 14:00 and 15:00 for the calm version. Note that a shop with the same name is not the same shop: the Suzuran-dōri original is gone and this is the successor run by its former head chef, so directions written before mid-2020 point at an empty building.

enrich_note: Confirmed at a real Jimbocho address. Nationwide Tabelog keyword search for キッチン南海 神保町 (double-encoded rstLst form, HTTP 200, 30件) returns キッチン南海 神保町店 = 13249021 as the top and only exact match; the detail page (iPhone UA, HTTP 200) carries Restaurant JSON-LD with 神田神保町1-39-8 ハウス神保町1F and coordinates 35.69484/139.76067, about 450 m from the sweep's approximate pin, so loc_precise is now true. Cross-checked against the Chiyoda City tourist association's own spot page, which independently gives the same address, phone and hours and supplies the succession story and prices. The light record's カツカレー・定食 and 神保町駅 both check out. One thing worth flagging for the merge: this is NOT the 1966 original — Tabelog's own note warns that the Suzuran-dōri 本店 closed in June 2020 and this is a separate のれん分け shop opened 2020-07-29 by the 本店's former head chef, so any older citation for 'Kitchen Nankai Jimbocho' describes a different address.

name: 麺処 花田 上野店
address_ja: 〒110-0005 東京都台東区上野6-8-6 上野メガネセンタービル 1F
cuisine: A miso-ramen specialist off Ameyoko: thick, garlicky miso broth over medium-thick noodles, with free extra vegetables and free extra garlic all day and free rice at weekday lunch — bowls under ¥1,000.
neighborhood: Ueno 6-chōme, in the Ueno Megane Center building on the Ameyoko side — 5 min from JR Ueno (Hirokōji exit), a short walk from Okachimachi (JR Yamanote/Keihin-Tōhoku) and Ueno-hirokōji (Tokyo Metro Ginza line).
hours_raw: 月〜土・日・祝　AM11:00〜22:30　定休日：年末年始
gf_detail: A miso ramen shop with no gluten-free claim of any kind. The noodles are wheat; the miso tare is nowhere stated to be rice-miso only, so barley miso (麦味噌) cannot be ruled out; and the seasoning behind it is ordinary wheat soy sauce. Fifteen seats, one noodle boiler, no separate-preparation route. Do not eat here on a gluten-free diet.
vegan_detail: Not vegan. The broth is animal stock and the bowls come with pork. The free vegetable topping (野菜大盛) and free garlic are generous but sit on top of a meat broth — there is no published plant-based bowl.

roles: 運営：エターナル (Eternal Company) — 麺処 花田 池袋本店 / 上野店 / まるはな
chef_bio.origin: Ikebukuro — 池袋本店 is the flagship; the Ueno shop is the second branch
chef_bio.background: 麺処 花田 is a small Tokyo miso-ramen group operated by Eternal Company, with 池袋本店 as the flagship and this Ueno branch opened on 10 September 2011 in the Ueno Megane Center building on the Ameyoko side of Ueno 6-chōme. The house style is a heavy, garlic-forward miso bowl, and the shop leans hard on volume: free large vegetables and free extra garlic at any hour, and free rice with weekday lunch. Fifteen seats, all non-smoking, cash only, no reservations. It holds a Tabelog 3.66 over 1,625 reviews. The group's own site is still actively maintained — the current page carries a New Year notice dated 23 December 2025 covering both branches.
chef_bio.specialty: 味噌ラーメン — the group's own site brands both branches simply as 味噌ラーメン. 終日、野菜大盛およびにんにく増し無料 (free vegetable pile and extra garlic all day); 平日(月〜金)ランチタイムはご飯無料 (free rice at weekday lunch).
chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: The group's own site (eternal-company.com/ueno.html, Shift-JIS) titles the page 上野店｜【麺処 花田】味噌ラーメン and gives 【営業時間】月〜土 日・祝 AM11:00〜22:30, 【住所】東京都台東区上野6-8-6上野メガネセンタービル1F, 【電話番号】03-3836-0440, and directions 「JR上野駅広小路口より徒歩５分」; the notice board carries a 2025.12/23 年末年始 announcement covering 池袋本店 and 上野店 together. Tabelog 13130960 gives the same address and phone, coordinates 35.70942/139.77558, 15 seats, all non-smoking, cash only, no reservations, opened 2011年9月10日, closed 年末年始, budget ～￥999, rating 3.66 / 1,625 reviews, and the note 「終日、野菜大盛およびにんにく増し無料。平日(月〜金)ランチタイムはご飯無料。」

gf_cross_contamination.text: Fifteen seats and a single noodle boiler running nothing but wheat ramen; no separate preparation is claimed anywhere.

cultural_comfort.note: A 15-seat counter ramen shop, cash only, no reservations, all non-smoking, open straight through to 22:30 every day including Sundays and holidays — which makes it one of the easier late options around Ameyoko. No English menu is published. The free vegetable pile and free extra garlic are opt-in at the counter, so say if you do not want them.

enrich_note: Confirmed, and the light record's own neighbourhood string turned out to be the building name. Nationwide Tabelog keyword search for 麺処 花田 上野 (double-encoded rstLst, HTTP 200, 7件) returns 麺処 花田 上野店 = 13130960 as the top exact match; the detail page (iPhone UA, HTTP 200) gives 台東区上野6-8-6 上野メガネセンタービル1F at 35.70942/139.77558 — the sweep's neighborhood field literally read 上野（メガネセンター）, which is this building, so the identification is unambiguous. The shop's own site at eternal-company.com/ueno.html (Shift-JIS, HTTP 200) independently confirms address, phone and 11:00–22:30 hours, and is currently maintained (notice dated 2025.12/23). Coordinates moved about 220 m from the approximate pin to the real address; loc_precise true. 味噌ラーメン in the light record matches the shop's own branding.

name: 麺巧 潮 上野製麺所
address_ja: 〒110-0015 東京都台東区東上野3-22-2 クレアツィオーネ上野 1F
cuisine: A chicken-paitan bowl that eats like a Western potage — cream stirred into the tare, low-temperature pork shoulder and duck chāshū, bacon-wrapped asparagus, broccoli and a poached egg on top; 鶏白湯そば 極 ¥1,390, with a black 'Nihon-ichi shōyu' bowl as the other half of the signature pair. Lunch only, and there is a terrace where dogs are welcome.
neighborhood: Higashi-Ueno 3-chōme, one street back from Asakusa-dōri — 5 min from Ueno (JR / Tokyo Metro) and 5 min from Inarichō (Tokyo Metro Ginza line).
gf_detail: No gluten-free provision and several separate gluten sources. The noodles are wheat; the shop's other signature bowl is built on a kaeshi of four soy sauces including 「日本一しょうゆ」 from Midori, Gunma — wheat soy sauce unless stated otherwise, and it is not stated otherwise; and the toppings include fried onion and fried bacon, which are normally flour-dusted. A 13-seat shop with one boiler. Nothing here can be made safe.
vegan_detail: Emphatically not vegan. The house bowl is chicken paitan with fresh cream in the tare, topped with pork chāshū, duck chāshū, bacon-wrapped asparagus, fried bacon and a poached egg. Dairy, egg, poultry and pork are all in the same bowl, and no plant-based version is published.

roles: restaurateur — ran Italian and other restaurants in Sendai before opening in Tokyo
chef_bio.origin: Sendai — he built a restaurant business there first, and 麺巧 潮 was his first ramen shop in Tokyo
chef_bio.background: 麺巧 潮 (Menkō Ushio) opened in Awajichō in 2012; 麺巧 潮 上野製麺所 is its sister shop, opened 15 June 2019 in Higashi-Ueno, one street off the traffic of Asakusa-dōri. Tsuchiya had spent his career on Italian and other restaurants in Sendai and deliberately did not want to copy an existing ramen: 「東京に進出するにあたり、好きなラーメンで勝負しようと思いました。ただ、既存のラーメンでは面白くないので、新たなブランドが確立できるようなラーメンを考案しました」. The result is a chicken paitan finished with fresh cream that reviewers compare to potage or carbonara, in a wood-toned room with counter, table and terrace seating that reads more like a café than a ramen shop — the black awning carries 潮 in white tensho seal script. Thirteen seats, lunch only, closed Sundays.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tsuchiya frames the two bowls as a matched pair: 「鶏白湯と対をなすのが、黒の“にほんいち醤油そば”。うちの店の二枚看板です。魚介系を中心にしたスープに、群馬県みどり市で醸造されている“日本一しょうゆ”という名前の醤油をはじめとした4種の醤油をかえしに入れています。」
chef_bio.specialty: 鶏白湯そば 極 ¥1,390 — cream in the tare, two chāshū (low-temperature pork shoulder plus duck), bacon-wrapped asparagus, broccoli, poached egg, fried onion and fried bacon; garlic butter ¥100 is the topping the shop pushes, and Tsuchiya recommends coarse black pepper to pull it back from carbonara territory to ramen.

anecdotes.text: There is a terrace where you can eat your ramen with your dog — unusual enough that 散歩の達人 photographed it.
A house 特製練り辛味 — chilli and sanshō ground into two chilli oils without heat — was added only because customers kept asking for it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: さんたつ by 散歩の達人 (san-tatsu.jp article 252091, updated 30 August 2023) interviews 店主 土屋幸男 on the record: 上野製麺所 opened 2019 as the sister shop of the 2012 Awajichō 麺巧 潮; he came from Italian and other restaurants in Sendai; the tare carries fresh cream; the 鶏白湯そば 極 is ¥1,390; garlic butter is ¥100; the black counterpart is にほんいち醤油そば using four soy sauces led by 日本一しょうゆ from みどり市, Gunma. The article's own footer gives 東京都台東区東上野3-22-2 クレアツィオーネ上野1F, 11:00～15:00, closed Sundays, 5 min from Ueno and from Inarichō. Tabelog 13235674 gives the same address, 03-6803-0897, coordinates 35.71103/139.77912, 13 seats, all non-smoking, cash only, no reservations, opened 2019年6月15日, hours 11:00–14:00 Mon/Sat and 11:00–15:00 Tue–Fri and holidays, closed Sunday, and a 3.52 rating over 253 reviews.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Thirteen seats, one noodle boiler, wheat noodles only; the fried onion and fried bacon garnishes add further flour exposure to the same bowl.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The shop's own description of the black bowl names four soy sauces in the kaeshi, led by 日本一しょうゆ from Midori, Gunma. No gluten-free tamari is claimed, so treat all of it as wheat soy sauce.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Fresh cream is in the tare itself, not just the toppings — there is no way to order the house bowl without dairy.

cultural_comfort.note: Easier than most ramen counters for a nervous visitor: you buy a ticket from the machine outside, so there is no spoken ordering, and the room is a bright wood-toned space with counter, table and terrace seats rather than a cramped standing bar. Thirteen seats, all non-smoking, cash only, no reservations. The terrace takes dogs. Lunch only — it shuts at 14:00 on Mondays and Saturdays and 15:00 the rest of the week, and closes entirely on Sundays, so this is not a dinner plan.

enrich_note: Confirmed. Nationwide Tabelog keyword search for 麺巧 潮 上野 (double-encoded rstLst, HTTP 200, 3件) returns 麺巧 潮 上野製麺所 = 13235674 plus the Awajichō parent 麺巧 潮 = 13147387, so the light record's exact name resolves to one shop; the detail page (iPhone UA, HTTP 200) gives 台東区東上野3-22-2 クレアツィオーネ上野1F at 35.71103/139.77912. That is about 450 m from the sweep's approximate pin and matches the light record's 稲荷町駅 neighbourhood string (Tabelog and the magazine both put it 5 min from Inarichō). The 鶏白湯ラーメン in the light record is exactly right — it is the house bowl. Owner name, background and the cream-in-the-tare detail come from a signed on-the-record interview in さんたつ by 散歩の達人, which also independently reproduces the address and hours. loc_precise true.

name: 鶏白湯ラーメン 鳥ぶし
address_ja: 〒110-0005 東京都台東区上野6-1-6 御徒町グリーンハイツ 1F
cuisine: A halal-certified chicken-paitan ramen bar a minute off Ameyoko — no pork, no alcohol, chicken chāshū, and your choice of coriander or spring onion on top; shōyu and paitan bowls around ¥1,000–¥1,500, with a chicken-broth rice set. Order from the ticket machine; there is an English menu.
neighborhood: Ueno 6-chōme, in the Okachimachi Green Heights building beside Ameyoko — 1–2 min from Okachimachi (JR Yamanote/Keihin-Tōhoku), 2 min from Ueno-hirokōji (Tokyo Metro Ginza line) and Naka-okachimachi (Hibiya line).
gf_detail: Halal is not gluten-free and the two must not be confused. The bowls are ordinary wheat ramen noodles, and the flagship 醤油らーめん is by definition a soy-sauce bowl — halal soy sauce is brewed without alcohol, but it is still made from wheat unless a tamari is named, and none is. Reviewers also record gyōza and karaage on the group's menu, both wheat. No gluten-free claim appears anywhere on the listing. The certification that makes this shop safe for a Muslim diner does nothing at all for a celiac one.
vegan_detail: Not vegan. The whole premise is chicken: chicken paitan broth, chicken chāshū, a chicken-broth rice side. The no-pork rule is religious, not plant-based, and no vegetable-broth bowl is published.

roles: 店主 (owner-chef, from Bangladesh; not named in any published source)
chef_bio.origin: Bangladesh — reported by a Tabelog reviewer who spoke to the shop
chef_bio.background: 鶏白湯ラーメン 鳥ぶし opened on 28 November 2022 in the Okachimachi Green Heights building, a minute off Ameyoko, and is one of a small number of halal-certified ramen shops in central Tokyo. The noren and the pavement sign both carry ハラル認証. The kitchen and floor staff are largely from the Middle East and South Asia and speak fluent Japanese, the room draws a visibly international crowd, and the shop keeps a multilingual (English) menu — an unusual amenity for a counter ramen bar. Ordering is by ticket machine. A same-name sister shop, 鶏白湯らーめん 鳥ぶし, trades at 豊島区東池袋1-13-12 near Ikebukuro and advertises the same halal certification and no-pork / no-alcohol policy on Gnavi ('Your Gateway to Authentic, 100% Halal Japanese Ramen').
chef_bio.specialty: 鶏白湯らーめん and 醤油らーめん — chicken broth with chicken chāshū and a choice of coriander or spring onion; there is a set with 鳥ダシご飯 (chicken-broth rice). At the Ikebukuro sister shop the same bowls are priced 醤油らーめん ¥1,130 and 味玉醬油らーめん ¥1,330.

anecdotes.text: A Tabelog reviewer noticed the room before the bowl: 「店内見渡すとお客さんも外国人。お店の方も外国人。後から入ってきたお客さんは頭を隠したベールを被った女性3人組。」 — then looked up what halal certification meant and understood why the broth was chicken.
Coriander is the default garnish but the counter will swap it for spring onion if you ask.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13279450 gives 台東区上野6-1-6 御徒町グリーンハイツ1F, 03-6284-2413, coordinates 35.70820/139.77613, all non-smoking, cash only, no reservations, opened 2022年11月28日, budget ￥1,000〜￥1,999, rating 3.29 over 114 reviews, and — unusually — the service flag 複数言語メニューあり（英語）. It publishes no opening hours. Reviews on the same page independently establish the halal side: 「お店の前におすすめのラーメンの看板とのれんには「ハラル認証」と書いてあります…こちらのお店は2022年オープンとのことで、バングラデシュ出身の店主さんが、ラーメンを提供しているとのこと」, plus a ticket machine, chicken chāshū and a coriander/negi choice. Gnavi (r.gnavi.co.jp/75vbza8f0000) covers the same-brand Ikebukuro shop 鶏白湯らーめん 鳥ぶし at 〒170-0013 東京都豊島区東池袋1-13-12, 03-5952-1313, 11:00〜23:00, 5 seats, badged ハラル認証店 / HALAL CERTIFIED with the line 「Your Gateway to Authentic, 100% Halal Japanese Ramen.（No Pork / No Alcohol）」 and menu photos at ¥1,130 / ¥1,330.

gf_cross_contamination.text: A small counter shop with one noodle boiler running wheat ramen only; the brand's menu also carries gyōza and karaage. Nothing here is prepared apart.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The house 醤油らーめん is a soy-sauce bowl. Halal certification requires the soy sauce to be alcohol-free; it does not make it wheat-free, and no tamari is claimed.

positives.text: The brand states its halal terms plainly in English — 'Your Gateway to Authentic, 100% Halal Japanese Ramen. (No Pork / No Alcohol)' — and the Okachimachi shop keeps an English menu, so a restricted-diet conversation is at least possible here in a way it is not at most ramen counters.

cultural_comfort.note: One of the most foreigner-friendly ramen counters in Ueno: an English menu is listed as a service on Tabelog, ordering is by ticket machine so you need no Japanese, staff and customers are visibly international, and the room is all non-smoking. Cash only, no reservations. For Muslim visitors this is a certified halal kitchen — no pork, no alcohol — which is rare in central Tokyo. Opening hours are not published anywhere I could reach, so phone 03-6284-2413 or check the door rather than planning a late arrival.

enrich_note: NAME CORRECTION. The light record read ハラール ラーメン 鳥ぶし; the shop's registered name is 鶏白湯ラーメン 鳥ぶし — 'halal' is what the noren advertises, not part of the name. Both halves of the light record check out. A nationwide Tabelog search for 鳥ぶし ハラール (double-encoded rstLst, HTTP 200) returned 0件 — the shop is not indexed under the halal word — so I re-ran on 鳥ぶし alone (HTTP 200, 54件), which puts 鶏白湯ラーメン 鳥ぶし = 13279450 in A1311/A131101 (上野・御徒町・湯島) at the top. The detail page (iPhone UA, HTTP 200) gives 台東区上野6-1-6 御徒町グリーンハイツ1F at 35.70820/139.77613, about 130 m from the sweep's approximate pin, and flags 複数言語メニューあり（英語）. The halal claim is corroborated by two independent Tabelog reviewers who photograph and quote the ハラル認証 sign on the noren and report a Bangladeshi owner, and by Gnavi's member page for the same-brand Ikebukuro shop, which carries the HALAL CERTIFIED badge and the No Pork / No Alcohol line. Confidence is medium rather than high only because I could not reach the certifying body's register or any shop-run site: Yahoo Japan returned HTTP 429 on three separate attempts spaced several minutes apart, DuckDuckGo's html and lite endpoints both returned HTTP 202 (bot challenge), and HotPepper and Retty keyword search both 404. Opening hours are genuinely unpublished on Tabelog, so hours_raw is left null rather than guessed.

name: 天寿ゞ（天寿々・てんすず）
cuisine: Edo-mae tempura fried to order in a 1928 detached house one street off Ameyoko — an eight-piece 天ぷら定食 with tentsuyu and salt, or 特上天丼 ¥2,860 (prawn, kasugo sea bream, conger eel, aubergine, shishitō and a small-prawn kakiage, with pickles and miso soup). Reckon on ¥2,000–¥3,000 at lunch and ¥6,000–¥8,000 at night.
neighborhood: Ueno 2-chōme, across the road from the Ameyoko crush and noticeably quieter — closest is Ueno-hirokōji (Tokyo Metro Ginza line); also short walks from Okachimachi (JR Yamanote/Keihin-Tōhoku), Naka-okachimachi (Hibiya line) and Ueno-okachimachi (Toei Ōedo line).
hours_raw: 月・火・木・金・土・日 11:00 - 14:00 / 16:30 - 21:00　水 定休日　※備考「26年9月より水・木休みとなります」（土日祝の昼の予約は11時入店のみ）
gf_detail: A tempura specialist is one of the least gluten-free rooms in Japan and this one makes no allergy claim. The batter is wheat flour, everything shares one pot of oil, the tentsuyu dipping broth is built on wheat soy sauce and mirin, and the tendon sauce poured over the rice is the same thing reduced. Even the salt-only route does not save you, because the coating itself is flour. There is nothing here a celiac can eat.
vegan_detail: Not vegan, and not straightforwardly vegetarian either. The tentsuyu is a katsuo-dashi broth, the miso soup that comes with the tendon is dashi-based, and the fixed sets are led by prawn, sea bream and conger eel. Vegetable pieces (lotus root, aubergine, shishitō) exist within the sets but are fried in the same oil as the seafood and served with the same fish-stock dip; no plant-based course is published.

roles: 職人 (tempura chefs at the counter; the current owner is not named in any published source)
chef_bio.origin: Ueno 2-chōme, Taitō-ku — the same detached house the shop has occupied since before the war
chef_bio.background: 天寿ゞ was founded in 1928 and is one of the older surviving Edo-mae tempura houses in Ueno. It occupies a freestanding building (Tabelog files it as 一軒家レストラン) on the quiet side of the road from Ameyoko: counter to the right as you pass the noren, tables and a sunken-hearth tatami room to the left, 30 seats in all with 11 at the counter. Tabelog selected it for 天ぷら 百名店 2023. It takes reservations, accepts cards and transport IC, has a private room and welcomes children — all of which make it markedly more approachable than the usual counter-only tempura-ya. One scheduling quirk: weekend and holiday lunch can only be reserved for the 11:00 opening, and reviewers report the room full by 11:40.
chef_bio.specialty: 天ぷら定食 松 — eight pieces fried in sequence at the counter, with tentsuyu and salt both offered; 特上天丼 ¥2,860 with prawn, kasugo sea bream, conger eel, aubergine, shishitō and a small-prawn kakiage, pickles and miso soup included. Regulars note the lotus root comes from Kaga.

anecdotes.text: A regular's summary of the neighbourhood: 「上野・御徒町でランチといえばとんかつって言う方が３割くらいいらっしゃるかも知れません。でも上野・御徒町といえば天ぷらです。天ぷらといえばもちろん『天寿ゞ』さんです。１９２８年創業です。」
Weekend lunch is a race: reservations are taken only for the 11:00 opening, and a reviewer who booked that slot watched the house fill by 11:40.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13008518, titled 天寿ゞ（天寿々 てんすず）- 上野御徒町/天ぷら, gives 台東区上野2-6-7, 03-3831-6360, coordinates 35.70886/139.77246, genre 天ぷら・天丼・日本料理, オープン日 1928年, 天ぷら百名店2023, 30 seats (11 counter, 12 table, plus 座敷), a private room, all non-smoking, cards (VISA/Master/JCB/AMEX/Diners) and transport IC and iD accepted, お通し ¥330 with no service charge, takeaway available, children welcome, budget ￥6,000〜￥7,999 dinner and ￥2,000〜￥2,999 lunch, hours 11:00–14:00 and 16:30–21:00 closed Wednesdays, the reservation rule 「土日祝の昼のご予約は11時入店のみ」, and the forward-dated note 「26年9月より水・木休みとなります」. Reviews on the same page supply the 1928 founding independently, the 特上天丼 at ¥2,860 with its exact contents, the 天ぷら定食 松 at eight pieces, and the layout of the room.

gf_cross_contamination.text: One tempura pot serves the entire menu and every piece that enters it is coated in wheat batter; there is no separate fryer and no allergy protocol published.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Both the tentsuyu dip and the tendon sauce are soy-sauce-based. No gluten-free tamari is mentioned anywhere.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Tentsuyu and the accompanying miso soup are bonito-dashi broths, so even the vegetable pieces arrive with fish stock.

cultural_comfort.note: Unusually easy for a near-century-old tempura house: reservations are accepted, cards and Suica/iD both work, there is a private room, children are welcome, the whole place is non-smoking, and you can sit at a table or in the tatami room rather than being pinned to the counter. Expect a ¥330 otōshi and no service charge. Two things to plan around — it is closed Wednesdays, and Tabelog carries the shop's own forward notice that from September 2026 it will close Thursdays as well; and at weekend or holiday lunch the only reservable slot is the 11:00 opening, with walk-ins after that taking their chances. No English menu is advertised.

enrich_note: Confirmed, with a spelling note rather than a name correction. A nationwide Tabelog search for 天寿々 御徒町 (double-encoded rstLst, HTTP 200) returned 1件 — 天寿ゞ = 13008518 — and Tabelog's own page title is 天寿ゞ（天寿々 てんすず）, so the light record's 天寿々 is the shop's own accepted alternate spelling of the same repetition mark, not a garbling. The detail page (iPhone UA, HTTP 200) gives 台東区上野2-6-7 at 35.70886/139.77246, about 300 m from the sweep's approximate pin, so loc_precise is now true; the light record's 天ぷら and 上野御徒町 both match. The 1928 founding is stated in the Tabelog オープン日 field and repeated independently by two reviewers. Worth flagging to the merge: the shop has posted a forward-dated change of closing days — 「26年9月より水・木休みとなります」 — which takes effect within weeks of this write-up, so hours_raw records both the current Wednesday-only closure and the coming Wednesday-and-Thursday one. Only one source URL is listed because Yahoo Japan returned HTTP 429 on repeated attempts and I would not cite a page I could not open; the Tabelog record is detailed and internally corroborated by its own reviews.

name: よし寿司 上野店
cuisine: A fifty-year-old Ueno sushi house that is also a banquet hall — Tsukiji fish delivered the morning you eat it, nigiri sets from about ¥1,200 at lunch, a chirashi-and-red-miso plate around ¥2,000, and drink-inclusive courses about ¥6,300 in the tatami private rooms upstairs.
neighborhood: Ueno 6-chōme, on the quieter street just north of the Ameyoko crowds — 3 min from Okachimachi (JR Yamanote/Keihin-Tōhoku), close to Ueno-hirokōji (Tokyo Metro Ginza line) and Naka-okachimachi (Hibiya line).
hours_raw: 月〜日・祝日・祝前日・祝後日 11:30 - 22:00（L.O. 21:30）　不定休日あり
gf_detail: Nothing is claimed and nothing is ruled out, so this is an ask-in-advance room rather than a safe one. In its favour: the core of the menu is nigiri and sashimi over vinegared rice, which is naturally wheat-free, and the kitchen is large enough and the shop reservation-based enough that a request can be made ahead. Against it: the house soy sauce will be wheat soy sauce — one reviewer specifically eats the ikura 「お醤油をつけずに」, which is the workaround, so bring your own tamari — and the seasonal menu carries 春野菜の天ぷら, meaning a wheat-batter fryer is running in the same kitchen. The sweet tamagoyaki is very likely to contain mirin and possibly flour. Ask before booking, name every item, and do not accept the table soy sauce.
vegan_detail: No. A Tsukiji-supplied sushi and seafood house: even the non-fish items sit in a dashi-and-fish context (red miso soup, chawanmushi, tamagoyaki), and the vegetable dishes on the seasonal list are fried alongside seafood. No plant-based set is published.

roles: 職人 (itamae at the ground-floor counter; not individually named in published sources)
運営：よし寿司 (YOSHIZUSHI) — 上野店 and 西川口店
chef_bio.background: よし寿司 has been trading in Ueno for more than fifty years — the shop's own tagline is 「創業50年以上。地域の皆様に愛され続ける老舗」 — and its pitch is 「うまくて安いが自慢」: good fish at prices that do not frighten. The company states that the fish is sent direct from Tsukiji on the morning it is served. The building works on three levels: a ground-floor counter where you can order nigiri one piece at a time even at lunchtime, tables on the second floor, and a third floor that is entirely sunken-hearth tatami private rooms, scaling from a four-seat room to a fifty-seat banquet hall — 110 seats in total. The group has contracted in recent years: the company's own notice board records 「よし寿司浦和店閉店のお知らせ」 in February 2024, leaving Ueno and Nishi-kawaguchi.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the company's own front page: 「うまくて安いが自慢のよし寿司。鮮度がよいこだわりのネタを使ったにぎりやチラシをお手頃なお値段にてご提供いたします。当日の朝、築地より直送された鮮魚で握る寿司と一品料理。」
chef_bio.specialty: にぎり sets from ¥1,200; a chirashi with red miso soup around ¥2,000 that reviewers single out for the fatty tuna in the tekkamaki; drink-inclusive banquet courses around ¥6,300 in the tatami rooms. Seasonal single plates run to そら豆, ほやの塩辛, ほたる烏賊, 初がつお, はまぐりの酒蒸し, 桜ますの木の芽焼, 春野菜の天ぷら, 鯛の桜ずし and a house-made tofu.

anecdotes.text: A reviewer's verdict on the value: chirashi plus red miso soup for ¥2,000 — 「ウーン、創業50年のなせる技なのか。近頃はイケテナイ回転寿司でもあっという間にそのぐらいの値段になってしまうので、このクオリティでこの価格は、庶民にとっては大変ありがたい！」
The old two-piece-minimum rule at lunch has been dropped — you can now order a single piece at a time, which regulars treat as the best reason to sit at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: The company site yoshizushi.co.jp is headed （公式）よし寿司　上野店, carries English and Chinese toggles, and gives 上野店 〒110-0005 東京都台東区上野6-7-8, TEL 03-5812-1678, the same-morning Tsukiji sourcing line, private rooms from a four-seat 掘り炬燵 up to a 50-person hall (parties of 3 to 50), a seasonal dish list, and a notice board whose entries run to 2025年12月24日 年末年始の営業について — including 2024年2月19日 よし寿司浦和店閉店のお知らせ. Tabelog 13158641 gives the same address and coordinates 35.70971/139.77597, genre 寿司・日本料理・居酒屋, hours 11:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30) seven days with 不定休日あり, 110 seats, private rooms in every size band up to 30+, 全席禁煙 with a second-floor smoking room, cards including UnionPay, free Wi-Fi, wheelchair accessible, dress code casual, homepage http://yoshizushi.co.jp, and a 3.47 rating over 327 reviews. Reviews supply 創業50年, the ¥1,200 nigiri set floor, the ¥2,000 chirashi and the ¥6,300 course.

gf_cross_contamination.text: The seasonal list includes 春野菜の天ぷら, so a wheat-batter fryer runs in the same kitchen as the sushi counter.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: House soy sauce is standard wheat soy sauce; a reviewer's own habit of eating the ikura 「お醤油をつけずに」 is the only wheat-free route recorded.

positives.text: It takes reservations and has a company office behind it, so a dietary request can be made in advance rather than shouted across a counter — and the site carries English and Chinese versions.

cultural_comfort.note: About as unintimidating as an old Ueno sushi house gets: reservations taken, cards including UnionPay accepted, free Wi-Fi, wheelchair access at the entrance, a casual dress code, English and Chinese versions of the company site, and 110 seats across three floors so you are not committed to a silent counter. Open straight through 11:30–22:00 (last orders 21:30), seven days, with occasional irregular closures. Private tatami rooms with sunken hearths take anything from four people to fifty, and there is a second-floor smoking room, so ask for a seat away from it if that matters. Note the cancellation policy is strict on course bookings — same-day cancellation is charged at 100%.

enrich_note: Confirmed, exactly as the light record named it. A nationwide Tabelog search for よし寿司 上野 (double-encoded rstLst, HTTP 200, 23件) returns よし寿司 上野店 = 13158641 as the only Tokyo-Ueno hit among a long tail of same-name shops in Iwate, Saitama, Shizuoka, Miyazaki, Hokkaido and Aichi — worth noting because the name is common enough that a careless match would have landed several prefectures away. The detail page (iPhone UA, HTTP 200) gives 台東区上野6-7-8 at 35.70971/139.77597, about 250 m from the sweep's approximate pin, and links a homepage; that homepage (yoshizushi.co.jp, HTTP 200) is the company's own and independently confirms the same address and phone under the heading （公式）よし寿司 上野店, with a notice board current to 24 December 2025. The light record's 江戸前寿司 and 中御徒町 both check out — Naka-okachimachi is one of the three stations that serve it. Its gf_confidence stays at the light record's 'ask' rather than moving up: the nigiri is naturally wheat-free but the house soy sauce is not, tempura is fried in the same kitchen, and the shop publishes no allergy policy. loc_precise true.
